name: Maintenance candidate-only runtime boundary
decision: KRN maintenance and dreaming work should run as a candidate-only maintenance/readback loop that reports readiness, reviewability, missing evidence, next action, and forbidden writes before any scheduler, daemon, source-truth mutation, or Memory Core mutation is introduced.
consumers: future candidate reviewability and missing-evidence gates
falsifier: A future maintenance or dreaming slice adds a scheduler, daemon, automatic memory/source mutation, or review-ready maintenance candidate without explicit evidence refs and reviewability reasons.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove maintenance scheduling, autonomous dreaming, candidate truth, source truth, Memory Core mutation safety, or KRN product readiness.
